author: hdprajwal
abstract: Execution discipline for building in thin vertical slices — implement one piece, test, verify, commit, expand — so the system stays working and committed between increments. Covers vertical / contract-first / risk-first slicing, simplicity-first and scope-discipline rules, feature-flagging incomplete work, and a per-increment checklist. Adapted from addyosmani/agent-skills' incremental-implementation skill. Tuned to hdprajwal's actual workflow (branch → PR → merge loop, specs in docs/, pnpm + cargo, runtime-proof verification, short plain prose) based on usage analysis.
